facts.text: The hotel's address is Piazza Fontana, 3, in Milan.
facts.excerpt: Piazza Fontana, 3

facts.text: The hotel's hallways wind through the building like a labyrinth.
facts.excerpt: The hallways of the Rosa Grand wind through the hotel like a labyrinth of luxury.

facts.text: In the refurbished rooms the dominant colour is peacock blue, with gold and pink accents.
facts.excerpt: In the newly refurbished rooms, the dominant colour is peacock blue, with gold and pink accents, complemented by touches of sage green, ivory and gold leaf.

facts.text: The rooms are complemented by touches of sage green, ivory and gold leaf.
facts.excerpt: complemented by touches of sage green, ivory and gold leaf

facts.text: The hotel reflects the Milanese taste for style and design and a passion for artistry.
facts.excerpt: Throughout the Rosa Grand you can appreciate the Milanese taste for style and design, and a passion for artistry.

facts.text: One room category is the Deluxe Duomo View room.
facts.excerpt: ### Deluxe Duomo View

facts.text: Rooms feature the Starbed and Pillowmania.
facts.excerpt:
- Starbed
- Pillowmania

facts.text: The wellness center has fitness facilities, a relaxation area and a solarium.
facts.excerpt:
- Fitness
- relaxation area and solarium

facts.text: A personal trainer is available on request and must be reserved in advance.
facts.excerpt: available upon request and must be reserved in advanced.

facts.text: The hotel has a Les Clefs d'Or concierge.
facts.excerpt: Les Clefs d’Or Concierge

facts.text: Guests can rent a car with a personal driver.
facts.excerpt: there’s a concierge service and the option to rent a car with a personal driver.

facts.text: A Porsche charging station is reserved for hotel guests as a complimentary service.
facts.excerpt: **Porsche** charging station reserved for hotel guests (complimentary service).

facts.text: Wi-Fi is free throughout the hotel and rooms.
facts.excerpt: The Wi-Fi internet connection is available throughout the whole hotel and rooms and is totally free.

facts.text: The hotel welcomes small and medium-sized pets for an additional charge.
facts.excerpt: The Pet Fee for Rosa Grand is €60.

facts.text: Smoking is not allowed in the rooms or public areas.
facts.excerpt: It is not allowed to smoke in the rooms and in the public areas of the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel has meeting rooms with natural light and a dedicated event manager.
facts.excerpt:
- Dedicated Event Manager
- Natural Light

facts.text: Sfizio, the hotel's flagship restaurant, has an outdoor terrace on Piazza Fontana enclosed by lush greenery.
facts.excerpt: Here guests may choose to dine on the charming outdoor terrace on Piazza Fontana, an ample space enclosed by lush greenery.

facts.text: Sfizio's menu changes daily and offers special children's menus and halal options.
facts.excerpt: The menu changes each day and can be adapted to the dietary needs of the guests, with special children’s menus and halal options.

facts.text: Breakfast at Roses features yogurt, fruit preserves and cheeses produced by small local farms.
facts.excerpt: The journey begins in the early morning at Roses with a breakfast of yogurt, fruit preserves and cheeses, all produced by small local farms.

facts.text: Roses Pizza & More serves gourmet pizzas overlooking Piazza Beccaria.
facts.excerpt: Here guests can enjoy gourmet pizzas and delicacies typical of Italian culinary tradition, while overlooking the elegant Piazza Beccaria.

facts.text: The Grand Lounge & Bar has fine gold detailing, waxed walls and elegant furnishings.
facts.excerpt: With its fine gold detailing, tasteful waxed walls and elegant furnishings, the Grand Lounge & Bar is the ultimate in contemporary style.

facts.text: Guests under 18 can only check in with a parent or official guardian.
facts.excerpt: Guests under the age of 18 can only check in with a parent or official guardian.

facts.text: Sfizio is described as a restaurant near the Duomo.
facts.excerpt: # Sfizio Restaurant near Duomo
